## VaultV1Actions.withdraw property

Prepares a withdraw from a VaultV1 (MetaMorpho) contract.

**Signature:**

```typescript
withdraw: (params: {
        amount: bigint;
        userAddress: Address;
    }) => {
        buildTx: () => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1WithdrawAction>>;
    };
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.amount`<!-- -->: Amount of assets to withdraw.

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: User address initiating the withdraw.
